facts.fact: Kunal checks Ila's right foot after the left: stiff and blotched but pinking, toes moving; only the two smallest left toes are dead.
Ila refuses to say what the sheets are for because Kunal's face would carry the answer to Raghu under the spyglass; she asks him to ask when no one can see him.
Kunal tells Raghu the sheets are ash because it is a lie Raghu cannot test, it costs Kunal nothing (Raghu is not his bound partner), and it keeps Raghu's search off Ila's seams.
Ila says she would have put the odds at one in ten if Kunal had handed the sheets over.
Kunal learned to skip stones on the shingle under the cliff at age nine, taught by Dhanu.
Gauri is named as Dhanu's sister on the page; she puts a hand on her brother's coat.
